description: This file implements a RuntimeCache class that manages a cache of runtime states associated with actor keys. It provides methods to get, set, clear, snapshot, and collect idle cache entries, primarily for caching and performance optimization within the control-plane runtime system.

classes.name: RuntimeCache
classes.description: A class that manages cached runtime states, allowing retrieval, updating, and snapshotting of cache entries.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of cache entries.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks whether a cache entry exists for the given actor key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state for the given actor key, optionally updating its last touched timestamp.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state for the given actor key without updating its last touched timestamp.

methods.name: getLastTouchedAt
methods.description: Returns the last touched timestamp for a given actor key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or updates the cache entry for a given actor key with a new runtime state and optional timestamp.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the cache entry for the specified actor key.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns an array of cached runtime snapshots, including idle time calculations.

methods.name: collectIdleCandidates
methods.description: Filters and returns cache entries that have been idle longer than the specified maximum idle milliseconds.

ctags.name: cache
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();$/

fields.name: private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();
